fact: The terms of reference, dated January 2025, state the Department of e-Government has established a National Data Centre in Lilongwe to host the majority of critical government systems and that MDAs presently host in silos, so priority systems of individual MDAs are to be migrated to it.
title: The Digital Malawi Acceleration Project: Terms of Reference for Consultancy Services to Migrate Government Data to the National Data Centre
publisher: Government of Malawi, Department of e-Government / Public Private Partnership Commission
